name: INPAQ Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: INPAQ Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, manufacture, and sale of miniature antennas and modules in Taiwan, China, Hong Kong, and internationally. The company offers RF antennas, including patch, active, chip, RFID, indoor and outdoor DAS, and customized antennas, as well as automotive, wireless power charger, and LDS technology products. It also provides RF modules comprising GNSS receive and wireless charging modules; inductors, such as SMD power, SMD signal, and RF inductors; over voltage protection products that include multilayer varistors, ESD suppressors, and TVS diodes; and EMI suppression filters, such as common mode chokes and ferrite chip bead products.
